product_one_liner.value: Upstage builds large language models and document-processing engines that help organizations make work processes smarter and more efficient.
product_one_liner.notes: Upstage describes its products as advanced language models and document-processing engines that help organizations improve work processes.

pricing_page.notes: Upstage has a public Pricing page with developer and enterprise plans and model pricing information.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The official customer success page features case studies for Amwins and Chosun Ilbo, identifying both as customers. | named_customers.0: The customer success page names Amwins in a case study. | named_customers.1: The customer success page names Chosun Ilbo in a case study.

employee_band.notes: The structured company record reports 260 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band; this is a secondary aggregate headcount rather than a company-published exact count.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The profile explicitly names Seoul as the headquarters city. | hq_country: The company profile explicitly identifies its headquarters as Seoul, South Korea.

founded_year.notes: Upstage's About page states that the company was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index lists the RAG-system and on-device-LLM posts. Their content covers implementation details such as embeddings and model quantization/engine optimization, rather than only marketing. The authorship is attributed to Upstage Team/named contributors, although their individual engineering titles are not specified, so this is a synthesis with some uncertainty.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal provides API setup instructions and links to separate documentation for agents, chat, document parsing, information extraction, classification, and embeddings, so it has multiple product-documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Upstage careers posting is titled AI Research Engineer - LLM Inference Optimization and includes an application link, meeting the AI/ML role criterion.

model_provider.notes: The developer documentation shows Solar Pro 4 as a model used in Upstage API calls, and the report identifies Solar models as independently developed by Upstage; together these support Upstage's proprietary Solar family as the publicly stated model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official security and compliance page says Upstage is certified for SOC 2, HIPAA, and ISO 27001/27701; the answer lists only the three requested certification names that match that claim. | compliance_certs.0: The compliance page names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The compliance page names HIPAA. | compliance_certs.2: The compliance page names ISO 27001/27701; ISO 27001 is the requested certification included.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The October 2026 agreement is explicitly identified as Series C-2. A November report refers to NVIDIA's participation in the ongoing second tranche, so the disclosed October investment is treated as the known first tranche of the same latest C-2 round. | funding_date: The cited report dates the signed Series C-2 first-tranche agreement to October 20, 2026, so the funding date is 2026-10. | funding_amount_usd: The October 2026 Series C-2 investment agreement is reported as $27.2 million and as the round's first investment. The round remained open, and later NVIDIA participation was reported without a disclosed amount; $27.2 million is the amount of the disclosed first tranche, not a claimed final total for the ongoing round.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 20, 2026 Series C-2 investment agreement was within the 18 months before November 9, 2026, so Upstage raised funding in the window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers posting is for a Sales Development Representative and includes an application link, matching the requested SDR/BDR/AE hiring scope.

launched_6mo.notes: Upstage's dated announcement says it launched the next-generation Upstage Studio on October 6, 2026, within the six-month period before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A June 2026 report says Upstage brought in Jin Yun-jeong as CFO and elevated existing executives into CSO and COO positions. The reported C-suite changes fall within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.
